jd:
Objectif du poste

Dana est un chef de file mondial dans la fourniture de technologies hautement spécialisées en transmission, en étanchéité et en gestion thermique, qui améliorent l'efficacité et la performance des véhicules équipés de groupes motopropulseurs conventionnels ou à énergie alternative.

Desservant trois marchés principaux les véhicules de tourisme, les camions commerciaux et les équipements hors route, Dana fournit aux fabricants d'équipement d'origine (OEM) ainsi qu'au marché secondaire (aftermarket) des produits et services de soutien locaux par l'intermédiaire d'un réseau de près de 100 installations d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de distribution.

Branche ta carrière et fais partie de notre force motrice ! Joins-toi à nous pour le développement et l’avancement d’une technologie propre, efficace et performante et contribues à l’essor de l’électrification des transports.

Notre équipe de logiciels embarqués a besoin d’un banc Hardware-in-the-Loop (mini-HIL) compact afin de tester le logiciel de contrôle d’onduleur sans moteur, sans étage de puissance et sans installation haute tension. Le mini-HIL est une carte électronique personnalisée (PCBA) qui se connecte à la carte de contrôle de l’onduleur. Il émule l’étage de puissance et le moteur en générant des signaux de capteurs réalistes.

Tâches et responsabilités du poste

Révolutionner le monde du transport, tout en:



- Analysant les schémas, le routage et la documentation existants du mini-HIL, puis en mettant en service et en déboguant le prototype actuel.
- Concevant les circuits d’émulation de signaux : étages DAC et amplificateurs opérationnels pour l’émulation des capteurs de courant et de tension, émulation de thermistances, émulation de résolveur synchronisée avec le signal d’excitation, ainsi que les capacités d’injection de défauts et de surpassement de signaux.
- Concevant les circuits d’acquisition pour les sorties PWM, les commandes de grille et les sorties numériques provenant de la carte produit, incluant l’adaptation de niveaux et la protection des entrées.
- Plaçant les composants et réalisant le routage de la PCBA.
- Mettant en service et validant la nouvelle carte à l’aide d’équipements de laboratoire (oscilloscope, alimentation électrique, générateur de signaux, multimètre).
- Développant le micrologiciel embarqué de la carte.
- Développant des scripts et des outils (p. ex. en Python) pour configurer, contrôler et automatiser les essais sur le banc mini-HIL.
- Documentant votre travail : notes de conception, schémas, guide de l’utilisateur et rapports d’essais.
- Effectuant toute autre tâche connexe.

Éducation Et Qualifications

Étudiant en génie électrique, génie informatique ou dans un domaine équivalent

 aptitudes



- Une expérience avec les outils de saisie de schémas et de conception de circuits imprimés (Altium Designer, KiCad ou équivalent), acquise dans le cadre de projets scolaires, d’un stage précédent ou de projets personnels.
- Des connaissances en circuits analogiques et à signaux mixtes : amplificateurs opérationnels, filtrage, ADC/DAC, conditionnement et protection des signaux.
- Une expérience en programmation C, C++ et Python.
- Une expérience avec les outils de développement logiciel (GIT, Azure DevOps, JIRA, etc.).
- Une expérience avec les microcontrôleurs 32 bits (Infineon, TI, ARM, etc.) et JTAG.
- Un esprit proactif et une grande autonomie.
- Une capacité à travailler au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
- Une capacité démontrée à bien documenter son travail.
- Une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
fit_why: Embedded/PCB hardware design; French fluency required, no web stack

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About The Role

Verkada is looking for software engineering interns to join our team for an exciting and challenging internship. We are seeking interns who will thrive in a startup culture working alongside teammates to launch products that will be utilized by customers across the globe. As an intern working with the Backend Engineering team, you will have opportunities to work across the full software stack and collaborate cross-functionally to build the latest iterations of Verkada’s flagship software enabling our best-in-class security systems.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do



- Build scalable distributed systems capable of handling high traffic from 100s of thousands of devices deployed around the world
- Work with high concurrency key-value storage systems (Redis, DynamoDB)
- Work with Postgres relational databases
- Work with logging and message passing technologies like Kafka and SQS
- Deploy services via Terraform and Kubernetes
- Develop large scale systems to interact with and configure products remotely
- Define and improve low-latency, high-throughput, high-reliability microservice architectures
- Design and develop features incorporating cutting edge computer vision
- Design clean APIs and implement them using Python and/or Go

What You Bring



- Ability to work at Verkada HQ during Summer 2027
- Actively pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or similar technical field of study and graduating by June 2028
- Prior internship experience developing and launching products
- Familiar with: Python or Golang, Distributed Systems, Operating Systems, AWS, Docker, etc
- Comfortable working in an agile team software development environment
- Familiar with REST APIs and Linux servers are a plus 

US Intern Benefits

At Verkada, we believe that internships should be as rewarding, supportive, and fun as they are impactful! That’s why we’re committed to providing a world-class experience that supports both your personal well-being and professional growth. Here are just a few of the perks and benefits you can expect as a Verkada Software Engineering intern:



- Monthly housing stipend in addition to a competitive hourly wage
- Wellness/fitness benefits
- Commuter benefits
- Daily lunch catered onsite, complimentary barista-made drinks, and fully stocked snacks to keep you fueled 
- Intern-exclusive events and mixers, including opportunities to connect with other interns across different teams
- Cross-functional collaboration opportunities, giving you real exposure to how teams work together at Verkada
- Lunch & Learns with company executives — hear directly from leaders and gain insight into building a successful career
- And more! From team-building activities to mentorship opportunities, we’re here to support your growth every step of the way

Additional Information



- We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. 

Pay Disclosure

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the factors described above, so the actual starting base pay may be above or below this range. Base pay is also just one component of Verkada’s total rewards package. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Estimated Hourly Pay Range

$55—$65 USD

Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Position Overview:
This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data science, laboratory research, and statistical analysis. *Note: Applications will remain live for at least 5 business days when the role is posted. The internship takes place in Summer 2027.


Program Highlights:

- Start strong from day one: Your first week is designed to help you build connections, settle in quickly, and get set up for success through cohort orientation, support, and structured onboarding.
- Every intern is paired with a mentor to support development, learning, and career exploration throughout the program, while also helping expand your network across the company.
- Feel supported throughout the experience: Interns receive ongoing coaching and guidance from managers, team navigators, and a dedicated Emerging Talent & Careers contact, so there is always a strong support system in place.


Responsibilities:

- Travel is so much more than simply reaching your destination.
- Along the way you will make an immediate impact on reimagining the way people search for travel with the company's awesome team by inventing brand-new techniques to power global travel for everyone, everywhere.
- From building pipelines and prototyping new ML models with A/B testing, to applying new techniques to services that run tens of thousands of requests per second, there is no shortage of opportunities for technical innovation at the company – the sky’s the limit!
- Design, prototype, and evaluate machine learning models under the guidance of more experienced machine learning scientists, contributing to well-scoped research and product-focused experiments.
- Implement clean, maintainable model training and inference code using standard Software Engineering practices, including basic unit testing, code reviews, and reproducible experimentation workflows.
- Participate in low-level system design, API design, and data modeling for ML-powered features, learning how to translate product and data requirements into robust, production-aware ML solutions.
- Explore, analyze, and prepare data using fundamental statistical and ML techniques to improve model quality, robustness, and fairness, including feature engineering and basic error analysis.
- Collaborate with peers, mentors, data scientists, engineers, and product partners to understand problem spaces, define success metrics, and iterate on ML solutions that deliver measurable impact.
- Learn to work with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes within defined guidance and scope.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Helpful to have theoretical understanding various machine learning topics like Regression, Naïve Bayes, Deep Learning, Gradient Boosting, Random Forests, SVMs, Neural Networks.
- Helpful to have experience with programming, statistical, and querying languages like Python, R, SQL/Hive, Java.
- Helpful to have understanding of distributed file systems, scalable datastores, distributed computing and related technologies (Spark, Hadoop, etc.); implementation experience of MapReduce techniques, in-memory data processing, etc.
- Helpful to be familiar with cloud computing, AWS specifically, in a distributed computing context.


Required Qualifications:

- You will take part in role-specific technical and professional skills learning, delivered through a mix of in-person and virtual sessions, to help you build confidence and capability from the start.
- Work on meaningful projects: Interns join the company and contribute to real business priorities and workstreams. At the end of the internship, you will showcase your work to team members and senior leaders.
- Grow beyond your day job: The company's Learning Series includes interactive workshops focused on professional development and workplace skills, with topics such as personal branding, communication, and presentation skills.
- Gain exposure to leaders: Through the company's Leadership Series, interns take part in exclusive events with Travel Leadership Team leaders to hear about their career journeys, learn more about the business, and ask questions directly.
- Build your network and community: You will join an intern cohort and take part in regular social events designed to help you build relationships, experience the company’s culture, and have fun along the way.
- We know that many potential candidates can be hesitant to apply for a job if they aren't sure that they meet all the criteria shared.
- May 24th – July 30th or June 21st – August 27th.
- Must be graduating with an Master’s degree in a technical subject (e.g. Master’s degree in a technical, or analytical-related, subject such as Computer Science with focus in areas like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Data Mining, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Operations Research, Electrical & Computer Engineering, or any Engineering degree) between December 2027 and July 2028.
- Must be willing to relocate to city of job location if outside commuting distance.
- Must have Python and/or Scala, SQL knowledge.


Perks & Benefits:

- Health benefits.
- Relocation assistance.


Compensation:
The compensation for this role is $52 per hour.


Procedure:
We are an HR consultancy firm, and we help candidates match with the potential roles by using an Artificial Intelligence System which is free of cost. If you meet the eligibility criteria, please apply and our Artificial Intelligence System will assess your fit for the role. We can let you know better once you submit your resume.

Archer is collaborating with Sage to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Please note that this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days in the office.

Great software starts with people who are curious enough to question how things work and bold enough to build something better. At Sage, you won’t spend your internship watching from the sidelines. You’ll contribute to real engineering work from day one.

At Sage, we create technology that helps businesses work more effectively and make better decisions. With colleagues and customers around the world, you’ll see how ideas become products and services with real impact.

Why join Sage?

This is not an internship built around observation or hypothetical exercises. You’ll join a live engineering team and work on technology connected to Sage, our products or our customers.

You’ll learn from experienced engineers, use modern development practices and see how software is designed, tested and delivered in a global technology business. You’ll have support from your manager, technical mentor and buddy, alongside structured learning and an intern community.

We’re looking for curious, motivated people who enjoy solving problems and want to turn ideas into working technology. You’ll contribute to team priorities while building your confidence as an engineer.

You Will



-  Design, develop and test software with support from experienced engineers
-  Break problems into manageable steps and compare different technical approaches
-  Write clear, maintainable code and respond constructively to review feedback
-  Use source control, testing and other engineering tools as part of day-to-day delivery
-  Investigate defects and use evidence to identify likely causes
-  Consider security, privacy, reliability, accessibility and performance when building solutions
-  Use approved AI tools thoughtfully, checking outputs with your own technical judgement
-  Share progress clearly and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other interns

Your Real-World Engineering Project

A key part of the internship will be a defined engineering project with a clear problem, audience and outcome. Depending on your team, this could involve building or improving software, exploring an AI-supported solution, working with data, testing AI outputs or developing a proof of concept.



-  Agree the scope and success measures
-  Explore different approaches before deciding what to build
-  Design, develop and test your solution
-  Use AI and engineering tools responsibly
-  Gather feedback through regular check-ins and a midpoint review
-  Present a working demonstration and explain your decisions
-  Reflect on what worked, what you would change and what you learned

What we are looking for

People who thrive here are curious, practical and willing to keep learning. We care more about your potential and thinking than the number of technologies you already know.

You may be studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical subject.

You Will Bring



-  An interest in building technology and understanding how it works
-  Fundamentals in at least one programming language
-  A structured approach to solving problems
-  The confidence to ask questions and try different approaches
-  Clear communication and the ability to explain your thinking
-  A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute to a team
-  Learning agility and openness to feedback
-  An interest in how AI is changing software development, balanced with human judgement

You do not need professional software engineering experience. University work, personal projects, hackathons, societies, work experience and experimenting with technology all count.

What you will gain



-  Hands-on experience with real engineering work
-  A completed project you can explain and demonstrate
-  Structured technical learning and regular feedback
-  Support from a manager, technical mentor and buddy
-  Experience of modern engineering practices and responsible AI use
-  Exposure to Sage leaders and colleagues across the business
-  A cohort of interns learning alongside you
-  Potential consideration for an approved 2028 graduate role, subject to performance, business need and eligibility

What you can expect from the process



-  Apply online with your resume
-  Complete the online assessments.
-  If successful, attend an assessment center or local selection event
-  Successful candidates will join our Summer 2027 internship program

Here at Sage, we are committed to inclusivity for all. If there are any adjustments that would help you thrive in the application process or during your internship, please contact earlycareersadjustments@sage.com For all other queries, please contact earlycareers@sage.com

jd:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a highly talented individual for a software application engineering internship position in MACH Division. The successful candidate will join a world-class team of algorithm and software application engineers to design and apply machine learning, image processing, IC design analysis and related algorithms for wafer inspection and metrology applications.

A key qualification of the candidate is the ability and passion to create and apply new ideas, analyze complex systems, formulate mathematical solutions and utilize machine learning workflows that are practical for use in production. The candidate is expected to possess good oral and written communications skills, and domestic or international travel involved for up to 30% (supporting cross-team collaboration projects, customer betas or visiting/training in China/US, etc.)

Detailed responsibilities include:



- Extract, analyze and model wafer inspection, review and metro data with IC desgin guides
- Evaluating and improving machine learning training sets and associated workflow processes
- Comparing and assessing various machine learning models
- Evaluating and improving analyticial model and machine learning model performance
- Evaluating and apply algorithms to improve signal to noise ratio from variety of image conditions (i.e., extracting information from noisy images)
- Working with product engineering teams to define performance specifications and deliver to those specifications


In addition to the above fundamental software skills, any of the following technical hands-on skills are highly desirable.



- Data Structures and algorithms
- Traditional machine learning using Random Forest, XG Boost, Logistic Regression.
- Deep Learning for regression, classification and Generative models.
- TensorFlow or Pytorch, NumPy, scikit-learn, and other ML and DL frameworks.
- Distributed systems for data management.
- Distributed computing infrastructure.
- Cloud technologies for storage, containerization and compute clusters.
- GPU architectures and data management.


Successful candidates for this position will also demonstrate the following non-technical skills.



- Capability to formulate creative solutions through analyzing complex data
- Good communication skills
- Strong team player and motivated by team success
- Strong problem-solving skills


Minimum Qualifications

Masters level degree student or a PhD candidate

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Total Rewards

Base Pay Range: $22.10 - $42.50 per hour based on pursuit of a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. Primary Location: USA-TX-Austin-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Use of AI Statement 

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

Equal Opportunity Statement

KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation.

For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jd:
